$comment: Golden cases of the aura level window (Wave 6, NOVA-23; tools/check_nui_snapshots.py): the default fixture is an aura at level 3 with 450 of 1.000 experience (45%, legacy's fill of 84 of 188 pixels as the fraction 0.4468) and a material stack of 5; empty: no aura and no material (legacy writes no text and hides the gauge); max: a level 250 aura with no material (the gauge full, MAX, no experience line). The window centers at its first show; the sheet's place frames it here. The modern looks keep room for the frame's shadow; classic draws legacy's 248 x 265 board (aura_levelupwindow.py) on its own canvas, with no background art (legacy's aura_levelup_bg.sub is not in the packs).
